semantic_changes: V2 is an intentional semantic revision of router v1, not byte-equivalent to the source or a proven content-preserving compiler transformation.
Discovery frontmatter and both example references remain byte-for-byte unchanged; only those example references retain complete verbatim-source mappings.
Project generation is revised, not a verbatim extraction: inspect the constitution independently of AVAILABLE_DOCS before creation or append.

Require rendered automatic/optional hook blocks with actual normalized command IDs; an execution/offer claim is insufficient. Optional hooks require explicit authorization; keep enabled/condition filtering and mandatory execution ordering.
Explicit user count and one-question-per-topic allocation take precedence over consolidation. Missing policy questions require Gap markers even when related requirements are cited.
Append preserves the complete existing byte prefix and checkbox states; select writes compatible with the current sandbox, avoiding temporary-file-dependent shell constructs when unavailable.

validation_scope.offline: Package integrity, original/discovery/example retention and tamper rejection; targeted workflow checker tests are separate.
validation_scope.fidelity_claim: Unvalidated candidate. Instruction changes and offline tests do not prove model compliance, semantic equivalence or runtime savings.
